description: This Java class defines AlarmStatusFilter, which encapsulates filtering logic for alarm statuses based on acknowledgment and clearance states. It provides static factory methods to create filters from various alarm status inputs and includes methods to check filter presence and match alarms against the filter criteria.

classes.name: AlarmStatusFilter
classes.description: A filter class for alarm statuses based on acknowledgment and clearance states.

methods.name: from(AlarmQuery query)
methods.description: Creates an AlarmStatusFilter based on the provided AlarmQuery object.

methods.name: from(AlarmSearchStatus alarmSearchStatus)
methods.description: Creates an AlarmStatusFilter from an AlarmSearchStatus enum value.

methods.name: from(AlarmStatus alarmStatus)
methods.description: Creates an AlarmStatusFilter from an AlarmStatus enum value.

methods.name: empty()
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance representing an empty filter.

methods.name: hasAnyFilter()
methods.description: Checks if any filter (clear or ack) is set.

methods.name: hasClearFilter()
methods.description: Checks if the clear filter is set.

methods.name: hasAckFilter()
methods.description: Checks if the acknowledgment filter is set.

methods.name: getClearFilter()
methods.description: Returns the value of the clear filter or throws if not set.

methods.name: getAckFilter()
methods.description: Returns the value of the acknowledgment filter or throws if not set.

methods.name: from(Collection<AlarmSearchStatus> statuses)
methods.description: Creates an AlarmStatusFilter from a collection of AlarmSearchStatus enums.

methods.name: matches(Alarm alarm)
methods.description: Checks if an Alarm object matches the filter criteria.
